"""design_9672 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"; OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_9672.json").read_text())

pat = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# tp = 퇴원 시각 (offset 0h)
adm = adm.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
adm["tp"] = adm["discharge_time"]

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
adm["next_admit"] = adm.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = adm["next_admit"] - adm["tp"]
adm["readmit_30d"] = ((gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = adm["admit_time"].max()  # 입원 기록의 마지막 시점(추적 종료 근사)
adm["fu_complete_30d"] = (adm["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# 코호트
df = adm.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(df)
df = df[df["age"] >= 18]; n1 = len(df)
df = df[df["discharge_status"] != "died"]; n2 = len(df)

# 특성
df["unit"] = df["unit"]
df["los_h"] = (df["discharge_time"] - df["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # 설계서의 length_of_stay_h는 데이터에 없어 계산
df["n_prior_adm"] = df.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 같은 환자의 이전 입원 수 (전체 adm 기준이므로 아래에서 재계산)
prior = adm.groupby("patient_id").cumcount(); df["n_prior_adm"] = prior.loc[df.index].values

# 진단: 시각이 없어 현재 입원 건의 코드로 한정 (확인 필요 항목)
cur_dx = dx[dx["admission_id"].isin(df["admission_id"])]
df["n_dx"] = df["admission_id"].map(cur_dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, code in [("dx_chf", "I50"), ("dx_ckd", "N18")]:
    ids = set(cur_dx.loc[cur_dx["icd_code"].str.startswith(code), "admission_id"])
    df[name] = df["admission_id"].isin(ids).astype(int)

def windowed(tab, tcol):
    t = tab.merge(df[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return t[(t[tcol] >= t["admit_time"]) & (t[tcol] <= t["tp"])]

o = windowed(orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
df["dialysis_ordered"] = df["admission_id"].isin(o["admission_id"]).astype(int)
cr = windowed(labs[labs["test"] == "creatinine"], "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
df["cr_last"] = df["admission_id"].map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
hb = windowed(labs[labs["test"] == "hemoglobin"], "report_time")
df["hgb_min"] = df["admission_id"].map(hb.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]

# 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. family_id 결측은 환자 단독 그룹으로 대체
df["split_group"] = df["family_id"].fillna(df["patient_id"])
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = df["split_group"].unique(); rng.shuffle(groups)
n_test = int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))
test_g = set(groups[:n_test])
df["split"] = np.where(df["split_group"].isin(test_g), "test", "train")

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "fu_complete_30d", "readmit_30d"] + feats
df[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analytic_dataset.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions": n0, "after_adult": n1, "after_excl_died": n2,
    "n_patients": int(df["patient_id"].nunique()),
    "readmit_30d_rate": round(df["readmit_30d"].mean(), 4),
    "readmit_by_discharge_status": df.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict(),
    "readmit_by_unit": df.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict(),
    "fu_incomplete_30d": int((~df["fu_complete_30d"]).sum()),
    "family_id_missing_rows": int(df["family_id"].isna().sum()),
    "split_rows": df["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_readmit_rate": df.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "missing_rate": df[feats].isna().mean().round(4)[lambda s: s > 0].to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_patients": int(len(set(df.loc[df.split=="train","patient_id"]) & set(df.loc[df.split=="test","patient_id"]))),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
